rules.title: App Router
rules.text: Use the App Router; keep components server components by default.

rules.title: Minimize client components
rules.text: Add "use client" only to the smallest components that need interactivity or browser APIs.

rules.title: Fetch on the server
rules.text: Fetch data in server components or route handlers, not in client effects.

rules.title: Env var exposure
rules.text: Expose only NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables to the browser and never put secrets in them.

rules.title: next/image and next/font
rules.text: Use next/image and next/font for images and fonts.

rules.title: Metadata API
rules.text: Define page metadata with the Metadata API.

rules.title: Validate server actions
rules.text: Treat server actions as public endpoints: validate input and check authorization inside them.

rules.title: Be explicit about caching
rules.text: Set caching and revalidation explicitly for each fetch and route.

rules.title: loading.tsx and error.tsx
rules.text: Provide loading.tsx and error.tsx for route segments that fetch data.

rules.title: Typed route handlers
rules.text: Validate route handler input and return typed JSON with correct status codes.
